EFFORTLESS HANDLING
The 2024 Outlander is a result of countless hours of engineering expertise. The platform
and suspension allow for effortless handling, creating a smoother ride for everyone. It's
2.5-liter 4-cylinder engine delivers enhanced horsepower and torque distribution to give
you seamless acceleration. Add the increased comfort and control that come with
Electric Power Steering that adjusts in different drive modes, and the line starts to blur
between where you end and the Outlander begins. By incorporating the latest
technologies, like direct injection, an electrically operated valve timing control system,
cooled exhaust gas recirculation, and mirror bore coating, the Outlander’s engine
balances fuel economy with acceleration performance.
FUEL�EFFICIENT DRIVING
The Outlander boasts an impressive combined rating of 27 MPG1 but did you know it can
take fuel economy even further? Made for environmentally-concious and fuel-efficient
driving, activate the Outlander's Eco Mode to reduce energy consumption and enjoy a
cleaner ride.
SUPER ALL�WHEEL CONTROL (S�AWC)
Perfected after decades of being put to the test on the rally course, Mitsubishi’s available,
signature Super All-Wheel Control (S�AWC) system is the evolution of 4WD technology. S-
AWC improves handling and stability by seamlessly managing the Outlander’s movements
during accelerating, cornering, and braking while keeping you comfortable and confident
behind the wheel. The Outlander's Drive Mode Selector adapts to different terrain and
weather conditions with the simple turn of a dial. By choosing between five drive modes -
eco, normal, tarmac, gravel, and snow - you can optimize driver control for a variety of
surfaces and situations. Plus, each mode stays in sync with your unique driving style so
that you can take command of any road, anywhere.

--- page 4 ---
DRIVING
ADVANCED DRIVER ASSISTANCE
Standard feature. Equipped with multiple standard Advanced Driver Assistance
Systems2, the 2024 Outlander features advanced safety technology. This can be seen in
features like Blind Spot Warning3, which monitors vehicles approaching your blind spot
and notifies you with a light in the corresponding side mirror. If your turning signal goes
on, the light flashes and a warning sounds. Should you then try to change lanes,
available Blind Spot Warning with Lane Change Assist3 will apply the brakes, helping to
avoid potential collisions.
COLLISION MITIGATION
Forward Collision Mitigation with Pedestrian Detection4 monitors for obstacles in front
of your vehicle and applies the brake to help avoid a potential collision. And, thanks to
Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Rear Automatic Emergency Braking3, the Outlander covers
your back too. Rear sensors detect nearby objects and sound an alert if objects are
detected.
MI�PILOT
Available MI�PILOT Assist5 is an advanced technological solution that helps reduce the
stress out of driving. Combining Adaptive Cruise Control6, with Lane Keep Assist5 and
Embedded Navigation5, this driver-assist system helps you stay centered on the road.
MI�PILOT Assist includes features that can adjust steering input, reduce speed to safely
navigate curves and keep pace in stop-and-go traffic. That means you can enjoy longer
and safer road trips without tiring out.
MULTI�VIEW CAMERA SYSTEM
The Outlander's available Mutli-View Camera System7 helps you confidently maneuver
tight corners and navigate parking lots. Using cameras mounted on the front, rear and
side of the vehicle to create a composite image, the system creates a 360 degree view
of your surroundings. With a better parking vantage point, getting around hard-to-see
areas becomes a lot more convenient.

--- page 5 ---
INTERIOR
INSIDE YOUR OUTLANDER
Seating preferences that are right every time. With eight available, unique power seating
adjustment options, the mirrors, digital cluster settings, and leather or semi-aniline leather
cushions all adjust to suit the driver’s body for a perfect, custom fit. And don’t forget: there’s an
available memory seat function key-linked to each driver.
